name: water
description: Showcase #2, water and underwater (seed 7, the coast ~17 km from spawn at 11700, 19500: a sandy beach, a lagoon and a river channel to the sea): a golden-hour glide to the shore, down the river to the mouth, wading in, the surface crossing, an underwater swim looking up, the player treading water at sunset.

shots.note: golden-hour coast: a slow low glide over the sea toward the beach
the river: down its channel through the sand to the lagoon and the sea, sped up
first person walking in off the beach, the surface rising to the camera until the head goes under
the transition: a camera slowly crossing the surface, half above and half below, then under looking up
first person under the water: swimming along the bottom with soft strokes, then looking up at the surface
surfacing: the player treading water, a third-person pull-back and rise at sunset
